import { getFreshSourceMapSupport, PLUGINS, AssetConfigSchema, RouterConfigSchema, UnsafeBindingSchema } from "./miniflare";
import type { Plugin, AssetConfig, RouterConfig, MiniflareBinding, SendEmailBinding, VpcNetworkBinding } from "./miniflare";

const plugin: Plugin = PLUGINS.core;
const asset: AssetConfig = AssetConfigSchema.parse({});
const router: RouterConfig = RouterConfigSchema.parse({});
const unsafe: MiniflareBinding = UnsafeBindingSchema.parse({ type: "unsafe:example" });
const email: SendEmailBinding = { type: "send-email", destinationAddress: "hello@example.com" };
const network: VpcNetworkBinding = { type: "vpc-network", networkId: "example" };
getFreshSourceMapSupport().install({ environment: "node" });
void [plugin, asset, router, unsafe, email, network];
